wallpaper.title: 盛夏海风 · 宝石撞色
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG of the canonical wallpaper. One adult woman with refined green-eyed face, copper-orange windblown hair, straw hat and opaque short-sleeved blue dress. Natural backward glance and hat-holding gesture; both visible arms and hands are coherent. Bright cyan sea, blue sky, magenta flowers and golden highlights. Clear sky above the hat, no text, watermark or unwanted people.

visible_description: 铜橘长发、翠绿眼睛的成年女性穿孔雀蓝短袖夏裙，扶着草帽沿海岸花径回望；青蓝海天、玫红花丛与金色透光发丝形成鲜明撞色。
